PTR receipt/seal stat dictionary names differ; comparison corrected by explicit schema mapping, without rehash or receipt changes.
verification_command_ledger: Read verify/SKILL.md; verifier executes assigned artifact gate directly, no delegation.
Python pathlib/json/hashlib/re/html/urllib.parse: whole file reads, ordered substitutions then LF, text digests, recursive JSON/JSONL privacy and record checks.
Git show and ls-tree: exact current selected blobs and inventories at specified publication commits.
Git diff-tree, check-ignore, status, rev-parse: mutation boundaries, forced ignored log, tracked state.
Python ast.parse: read retained PTR adapters as text only.
Python os.open/fchmod/write/flush/fsync + directory fsync + full readback: private outputs.
